name: Apart Garni Bergkristall
beschreibung: The Apart Garni Bergkristall is a holiday home in Tyrol. Rented as a whole property, it offers generous privacy. The house features several bedrooms and a spacious living area. A fully equipped kitchen enables effortless self-catering. Amenities also include a garden or terrace. The holiday home serves as a convenient base for exploring the surrounding alpine region. On-site parking spaces are available directly at the house.
